name: Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins
summary:
Jonathan Septer Kreiss-Tomkins (born February 7, 1989), also known by his initials as JKT, is an American politician who is the governor-elect of Alaska. A member of the Democratic Party, he served from 2013 to 2023 as a member of the Alaska House of Representatives from the 35th district.
Born and raised in Sitka, Kreiss-Tomkins attended Yale University until his election to the Alaska House of Representatives in 2012.
